caption: The drawing depicts a light-colored dress, likely beige or cream, with short puffed sleeves each adorned with a large bow. The bodice features decorative lacing at the center, bordered by blue and green floral embroidery extending from the waist upward toward the sleeves. The skirt of the dress is gathered at the waist and falls to about ankle length, with an embroidered floral border along the bottom consisting of blue, pink, and green motifs. The dress is set against a plain background. To the right of the main drawing, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the dress showing the back view, which mirrors the overall shape and some details of the garment. The artist’s signature, “Mary Humes,” appears at the bottom right.
title: Child's Dress
